layout.whyThisMail: You get this email because “{{category}}” is switched on in your notifications.

verify.subject: Confirm your email address for {{brand}}
verify.heading: Confirm your email address
verify.text: Thank you for signing up with {{brand}}! Please use the following code to confirm your email address:
verify.expiry: This code is valid for 15 minutes.

reset.subject: Reset your {{brand}} password
reset.heading: Reset password
reset.text: We received a password reset request for your account. Use the following code to set a new password:

pending.subject: New bazaar waiting for approval: {{title}}
pending.heading: New bazaar waiting for approval
pending.text: {{name}} wants to publish a public bazaar. It only appears on the start page after your approval.
pending.footnote: You get this email because you are an administrator at BazarPro.

moderation.appeal: If you think the decision is wrong, reply via the contact form. We will review it again.

productHidden.subject: Your item “{{title}}” was hidden
productHidden.heading: Item hidden
productHidden.text: Our moderation team reviewed your item and hid it from other users for now. You can still see it in your account.

productRestored.subject: Your item “{{title}}” is visible again
productRestored.heading: Item visible again
productRestored.text: We lifted the restriction. Your item is visible to everyone again.

eventHidden.subject: Your event “{{title}}” was blocked
eventHidden.heading: Event blocked
eventHidden.text: Our moderation team blocked your event. Visitors and sellers can no longer see it; you and your team can still manage it.

eventRestored.subject: Your event “{{title}}” is visible again
eventRestored.heading: Block lifted
eventRestored.text: We lifted the block on your event.

questionDeleted.subject: Your question was removed
questionDeleted.heading: Question removed
questionDeleted.text: Our moderation team removed your question.
questionDeleted.textProduct: Our moderation team removed your question about the item “{{title}}”.
questionDeleted.question: Your question

banned.subject: Your {{brand}} account was suspended
banned.heading: Account suspended
banned.text: We suspended your account for violating our terms of use.
banned.appeal: If you think the decision is wrong, write to us via the contact form.

closed.subject: Your report was handled
closed.heading: Thank you for your report
closed.resolved: We reviewed your report and restricted the content.
closed.dismissed: We reviewed your report. In our view the content does not break our rules, so it stays visible.

new.subject: New report: {{label}}
new.heading: New report received
new.text: Content on {{brand}} was reported. Please review it soon.
new.footnote: You get this email because you are an administrator at {{brand}}.

rejected.subject: Your bazaar “{{title}}” was not approved
rejected.heading: Bazaar not approved
rejected.text: We reviewed your public bazaar and unfortunately cannot publish it like this.
rejected.resubmit: You can adjust the bazaar and submit it for review again in the settings.

new.subject: New question about “{{title}}”
new.heading: New question about your item
new.footnote: Your answer is visible to everyone who views the item.

new.subject: New price offer for “{{title}}”
new.heading: New price offer
new.footnote: Valid for “{{event}}”. If you accept, the buyer can buy the item there at this price.

accepted.subject: Your price offer for “{{title}}” was accepted
accepted.heading: Offer accepted
accepted.payAt: You pay on site at “{{event}}”. Tell the cash desk your name, the agreed price is stored there.
accepted.payAtEvent: You pay on site at the event. Tell the cash desk your name, the agreed price is stored there.

rejected.subject: Your price offer for “{{title}}” was declined
rejected.heading: Offer declined
rejected.text: The seller does not want to sell “{{title}}” for {{amount}}. You can make a new offer.
rejected.other: The seller accepted another offer for “{{title}}”.

closed.subject: “{{title}}” is no longer available
closed.heading: Item no longer available
closed.text: “{{title}}” is no longer available, so your price offer of {{amount}} no longer applies.

reopened.subject: Your price offer for “{{title}}” is valid again
reopened.heading: Price offer valid again
reopened.text: “{{title}}” is available again after all. Sorry for the previous message.
reopened.accepted: The agreed price of {{amount}} still applies.
reopened.pending: Your offer of {{amount}} is open again, the seller can accept it.

expired.subject: Your price offer for “{{title}}” has expired
expired.heading: Price offer expired
expired.accepted: “{{event}}” is over. The agreed price of {{amount}} for “{{title}}” no longer applies.
expired.pending: “{{event}}” is over and the seller did not answer your offer of {{amount}} for “{{title}}”. The offer no longer applies.

withdrawn.subject: Price offer for “{{title}}” withdrawn
withdrawn.heading: Price offer withdrawn
withdrawn.pending: The buyer deleted their account. Their offer of {{amount}} for “{{title}}” no longer applies.
withdrawn.accepted: The buyer deleted their account. The agreed price of {{amount}} for “{{title}}” no longer applies; the item is available at its regular price again.

sale.footnote: You receive the payout from the organizer.

many.text_one: {{count}} of your items was just sold at “{{event}}”.
many.text_other: {{count}} of your items were just sold at “{{event}}”.

receipt.heading: Thank you for your purchase
receipt.footnote: Please keep this email as your receipt. Your address was only used for this receipt and was not stored.

one.subject: Your receipt: {{title}}
one.text: You bought the following item at “{{event}}”. It is sold by a private person; the event only arranges the sale.

many.text: You bought the following items at “{{event}}”. They are sold by private persons; the event only arranges the sale.

reminder.contact: Questions? You can reach the organizer at: {{contact}}

dayBefore.subject: Almost time: {{event}}
dayBefore.heading: Everything you need for “{{event}}”
dayBefore.items_one: You registered {{count}} item. Print the labels beforehand (My products → Labels as PDF) and attach them to the items.
dayBefore.items_other: You registered {{count}} items. Print the labels beforehand (My products → Labels as PDF) and attach them to the items.
dayBefore.dropoff: Bring your items to the hand-in: {{dropoff}}.
dayBefore.digitalId: Show the digital ID from your account at the hand-in, it makes things faster.

pickup.subject: Pickup: {{event}}
pickup.heading: Pick up your items and your money

export.subject: Save the settlement: {{event}}
export.heading: Export the settlement of “{{event}}”
export.settlementEnds: The settlement period ends on {{date}}. After that, sales and returns can no longer be changed, and the sold items are deleted with their images. The settlement is kept.
export.archiveEnds: From {{date}} on, only the team sees the bazaar. Its cover image, map, description and messages are deleted then. The settlement is kept until the end of {{year}} and deleted afterwards.
export.duty: As the organizer, you have to keep the settlement yourself (§ 147 AO). Export it as CSV or PDF and file it with your records.
